dogecoin.text:
It hurts to see $doge pump right when these streams went live. This is a well-planned scam. Even I was confused for a few seconds.

Hope the streams are not the reason for the Doge coin pump, but it very well could be.

Some really big scammers are pushing these fake live streams on youtube about dogecoin. 
The tweet is fake and the stream is from an old NASA Livestream.

THIS IS FAKE. PLEASE DO NOT FALL FOR THIS.
